provisions.title: Short title and commencement
provisions.notes: Title and commencement date (1st April 2011). Administrative metadata; not a product check.

provisions.title: Definitions
provisions.notes: Statutory definitions (pre-packaged commodity, retail/wholesale package, industrial/institutional consumer, PDP, net qty). Informs canonical facts classification.

provisions.title: Application of Chapter II (Retail packages)
provisions.notes: Gates Chapter II applicability to retail packages; excludes wholesale, industrial, institutional, and export packs.

provisions.title: Regulation for pre-packing and sale in packaged form (multipack / combination pack)
provisions.notes: Represented as LMPC-4-MULTIPACK. Currently verifies individual pack count and net quantity declarations; needs full combination-pack clause support.

provisions.title: Specific commodities to be packed in specified quantities (Standard pack sizes)
provisions.notes: Represented as LMPC-5-STANDARD-PACK-SIZE. Currently relies on pre-evaluated context.pack_size_is_standard rather than internal Second Schedule table lookup.

provisions.title: Name and address of manufacturer / packer / importer
provisions.notes: Represented as LMPC-6-1-A-MANUFACTURER. Verifies presence; needs street/city/state/pin completeness check per Rule 10.

provisions.title: Generic or common name of commodity
provisions.notes: Represented as LMPC-6-1-B-COMMON-NAME. Verifies presence of common name.

provisions.title: Net quantity in standard unit of weight, measure or number
provisions.notes: Represented as LMPC-6-1-E-NET-QUANTITY. Verifies value and unit presence; needs Third Schedule symbol and Rule 12 standard unit validation.

provisions.title: Month and year of manufacture or packing or import
provisions.notes: Represented as LMPC-6-1-D-MFG-DATE. Checks declaration presence; needs month/year formatting check.

provisions.title: Best before / use by / expiry date for commodities that become unfit for consumption
provisions.notes: Represented as LMPC-6-1-D-BEST-BEFORE. Gated by category_requires_best_before flag.

provisions.title: Retail sale price (MRP inclusive of all taxes)
provisions.notes: Represented as LMPC-6-1-DA-MRP. Verifies MRP presence and mandatory 'inclusive of all taxes' clause.

provisions.title: Sizes and dimensions of commodities where relevant
provisions.notes: Applies to commodities sold by dimensions (e.g., bedsheets, pipes, textiles per Rule 14).

provisions.title: Consumer care details (name, address, phone, email)
provisions.notes: Represented as LMPC-6-1-DA-F-CONSUMER-CARE. Checks general presence; needs individual sub-field verification (telephone, email, address).

provisions.title: Country of origin or manufacture/assembly for imported packages
provisions.notes: Represented as LMPC-6-1-A-COUNTRY-OF-ORIGIN. Applicable when is_imported=True.

provisions.title: Unit sale price (USP) declaration and mathematical tolerance
provisions.notes: Represented as LMPC-6-11-UNIT-PRICE. Checks declared vs expected within 1% tolerance; needs dynamic computation using Decimal and base unit normalization (per g/kg/ml/l/no).

provisions.title: Conspicuousness and legibility of declarations
provisions.notes: Mandates clear, prominent, distinct declarations contrasting with background.

provisions.title: Deemed manufacturer / packer when sold under brand name
provisions.notes: Legal attribution rule: brand owner deemed manufacturer unless actual manufacturer declared.

provisions.title: Declarations on packages containing seeds
provisions.notes: Special category requirement for seeds.

provisions.title: QR code / barcode declarations on e-commerce packages
provisions.notes: Provision allowing QR code for certain declarations on electronic/e-commerce products.

provisions.title: Declarations for electronic products
provisions.notes: Specific packaging rules for electronic items.

provisions.title: Garment and hosiery size declarations
provisions.notes: Standard sizes in cm/inches for apparel.

provisions.title: Declarations on second-hand / reconditioned packages
provisions.notes: Mandates explicit marking of 'second-hand' or 'reconditioned'.

provisions.title: Principal display panel (PDP) area, size and letter/numeral height
provisions.notes: Represented as LMPC-7-NUMERAL-HEIGHT. Currently requires external threshold; must dynamically compute PDP area and look up Seventh Schedule table.

provisions.title: Declaration where to appear (on Principal Display Panel)
provisions.notes: Requires all statutory declarations to be grouped on PDP or display panel.

provisions.title: Manner in which declaration shall be made
provisions.notes: Must not be obscured by price sticker; non-washable ink; clear contrasting font.

provisions.title: Declaration of name and address of manufacturer, etc.
provisions.notes: Defines complete postal address requirement for Rule 6(1)(a).

provisions.title: General provisions relating to declaration of quantity
provisions.notes: Net quantity exclusive of wrappers and tare weight.

provisions.title: Manner of declaration of quantity
provisions.notes: Standard unit selection: mass for solid, volume for liquid/viscous, length/number; no non-decimal fractions.

provisions.title: Statement of units of weight, measure or number (Third Schedule)
provisions.notes: Enforces Third Schedule standard symbols (kg, g, mg, l, ml, m, cm, mm, N, U).

provisions.title: Declarations on packages containing commodities packed in dimensions
provisions.notes: Dimensional declarations for sheets, rolls, coils.

provisions.title: Declaration of quantity in relation to commodities packed on basis of number
provisions.notes: Count declaration format for Fifth Schedule commodities.

provisions.title: Units with reference to which retail sale price to be indicated
provisions.notes: Format of retail sale price indicating unit reference.

provisions.title: Additional declarations
provisions.notes: Permits voluntary marks (ISI/AGMARK) provided they do not dilute or contradict mandatory declarations.

provisions.title: Provisions relating to wholesale dealer and retail dealer
provisions.notes: Prohibits selling above MRP or altering/smudging declared MRP.

provisions.title: Inspection of quantity in packages (Powers of inspection)
provisions.notes: Statutory power of Director/Controller/Legal Metrology Officers to inspect and draw samples.

provisions.title: Action to be taken on completion of inspection
provisions.notes: Seizure, sampling, and reporting procedures.

provisions.title: Testing of packages at premises of manufacturer or packer
provisions.notes: Batch testing procedures at manufacturer premises using Sixth Schedule sampling plan and First Schedule MPE.

provisions.title: Inspection of premises of dealer
provisions.notes: Inspection powers at retail dealer premises.

provisions.title: Establishment of maximum permissible error (MPE)
provisions.notes: Evaluates net quantity against First Schedule MPE table and Fourth Schedule moisture loss limits.

provisions.title: Provisions applicable to wholesale packages
provisions.notes: Governs declarations on wholesale packages (name, address, net qty, wholesale price).

provisions.title: Exemption for export packages and wholesale packages
provisions.notes: Represented as LMPC-25-EXPORT. Exempts packages meant for export from Chapter II retail declarations.

provisions.title: Exemption for small packages (net weight/measure <= 10g or 10ml)
provisions.notes: General statutory small-pack exemption (except tobacco). Critical exemption currently simulated via generic flag.

provisions.title: Exemption for fast food items packed by restaurant or hotel
provisions.notes: Represented as LMPC-26-B-FAST-FOOD. Exempts fast food packages prepared and served by hotel/restaurant.

provisions.title: Exemption for scheduled formulations / drug formulations
provisions.notes: Represented as LMPC-26-C-DRUG-FORMULATIONS. Exempts drugs covered under Drugs & Cosmetics Rules, 1945.

provisions.title: Exemption for agricultural produce packages > 50 kg
provisions.notes: Exempts bulk agricultural commodity packages (>50kg).

provisions.title: Exemption for industrial consumers and institutional consumers
provisions.notes: Exempts direct sales to industrial consumers (manufacturing use) and institutional consumers (transport/hotel/hospital direct use).

provisions.title: Registration of manufacturers, packers and importers
provisions.notes: Represented as LMPC-27-REGISTRATION. Evaluates actor registration obligation; entity-level rather than product label check.

provisions.title: Application for registration
provisions.notes: Procedural details for filing Form 1 registration.

provisions.title: Maintenance of records / registers
provisions.notes: Record keeping requirements for packers and manufacturers.

provisions.title: Compilation of lists of manufacturers, packers, importers
provisions.notes: Director/Controller registry compilation duty.

provisions.title: Advertisement of pre-packaged commodities
provisions.notes: Represented as LMPC-31-ADVERTISEMENT. Requires retail sale price and net quantity to be declared on advertisements.

provisions.title: Penalty for contravention of rules
provisions.notes: Specifies fines and penalties for contraventions under the Act. Informational/audit reference.

provisions.title: Power to relax
provisions.notes: Government administrative power to grant relaxations.

provisions.title: Repeal and savings
provisions.notes: Repeals 1977 Rules while saving actions taken thereunder.

provisions.title: Maximum permissible error on net quantity
provisions.notes: Structured table of nominal quantity (g/ml) vs maximum permissible error in % or g/ml.

provisions.title: Commodities to be packed in specified quantities (Standard pack sizes)
provisions.notes: Structured table of 19+ commodity classes and permitted packaging increments/quantities.

provisions.title: Manner of declaration of units and symbols
provisions.notes: Statutory SI unit symbols (kg, g, mg, l, ml, m, cm, mm, number) and formatting constraints.

provisions.title: Exceptions referred to in Rule 12(2) & permissible errors on moisture loss
provisions.notes: SOURCE_DATA_MISSING: Tolerances for moisture-depleting commodities (soaps, dry fruits). Full schedule table not in available source material (gazette_raw.txt is 2025 amendment only).

provisions.title: Commodities to be sold by number
provisions.notes: SOURCE_DATA_MISSING: List of commodities permitted or required to be sold by count. Full schedule commodity list not in available source material (gazette_raw.txt is 2025 amendment only).

provisions.title: Method of testing packages (Sampling plan & inspection procedure)
provisions.notes: Statistical sampling plans (lot size vs sample size, acceptable defective packages).

provisions.title: Minimum height of numerals and letters for declarations
provisions.notes: Structured table mapping PDP area (cm²) to minimum numeral/letter height (mm) for normal vs blown/moulded containers.
